first_moves.move: Prove one complete authenticated GTM journey and its visual direction. Existing maintainers must name a product designer, engineer and independent craft reviewer before adoption; scope and estimate follow the frozen baseline.
first_moves.acceptance: Explore three materially different models with the same task/content; select and review five paired examples and complete motion sequences. Record request, streaming, approval, interruption, seeded failure, safe retry, artifact use and reopening with provenance and provider receipts. Counterbalance ten target users across equivalent frozen tasks. At least nine identify state/next action within five seconds and nine recover unaided without duplicate effects. Target half baseline all-assigned median active time, with unchanged correctness and no lower completion; count incomplete tasks at the frozen timeout and report failures, completion and successful-task times separately. Independent craft verdicts and deidentified recognition results remain separate. No 10x claim from this study.

first_moves.move: Extract proven shared interaction recipes and validate them in Router. Named Brand UI maintainer and Router consumer engineer own adoption through existing packages.
first_moves.acceptance: Real consumer stories and matched recordings establish distinct press feedback, anchored/interruptible mobile navigation without the recorded 306 px content jump, artifact continuity where applicable and no routine docs entrance on Back. Add Router to the existing drift registry/baseline and record installed revision, scanned commit and coverage limits. Pass keyboard, physical-touch, manual screen-reader, reflow/zoom, reduced CSS/JavaScript motion and callback-independent completion checks; source counts alone cannot pass.

first_moves.acceptance: Package the bible, human-approved examples, recordings, evidence definitions and rule reconciliation with accessible links. Resolve eight conflicts; map each moved/retired clause, count live readers and update incoming references before retirement. Retain unmapped rules, history and unresolved artifact-design ownership. Record exception rule/scope/evidence/mitigation/independent approver/expiry; expired exceptions need renewal or fix, and invariants remain nonwaivable. A fresh task follows the guide and shared owner without copying values; independent craft and consumer proof decide adoption. Determine staffing from measured ownership/capacity gaps.
